Binomial extraction proves the four optimal counts and lower-weight zero obstructions for all m>=3. Independent support/backtracking enumeration agrees for 30 cases of length 3..12; all matrix computations are exact integers.

value.rationale: The known minimum weight does not describe the solution space. The count of labelled optimal singleton assignments is a natural invariant for the standard cubic cycle prism, and the exact formulas reveal distinct constant, linear and quadratic regimes depending on m modulo six. This is a complete infinite-family refinement of a newly analyzed model, with structural meaning and a reproducible exact method; no arbitrary isolated slice or textbook identity.
